text: APPROVE. The loop moves unchanged into `AnnotatedArrowParameterClose`, where `break` becomes `return -1` and the match becomes `return k - 1`, which is the same as the old `close = -1` fall-through, so behaviour is preserved. Moving the nested `for`/`if`/`||`/`&&` out of the `else` should drop the method well below 15, and the helper is `private static` with a `<summary>` doc comment, so I see nothing that would trip warnings-as-errors. I haven't built it or seen the top of the method, so this assumes `close` starts at -1 and `tokens` is a list type that converts to `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>`.
